summary: Primary Chat progress asset publication now uses the existing chat-message-mirror workflow to deterministically compile the served index reference as ./progress-v1.js?v=<first12(sha256(asset_bytes))>. A reusable compiler and regression were added; the workflow stages, tests, and publishes the versioned HTML and asset together. GitHub Actions run 36919307873 passed the new asset-versioning gate and the existing contract harness, then published gh-pages commit 620c2ecdea35bfd0ee341ad046a5a19b0f165216. Current gh-pages index references ./progress-v1.js?v=e8cd7b608e1d and current main/gh-pages progress-v1.js bytes were byte-identical before publication. This runtime does not provide a representative JavaScript browser, so user-visible rendering of the capacity block is not claimed as SERVED_UI_PASS.
